            body = b'<!doctype html><meta charset="utf-8"><title>Synthetic PCM fixture</title><button>Run isolated PCM</button>'
            mime = 'text/html'

            name = self.path.split('?', 1)[0]

            if not name.startswith('/fc/') or '..' in name:
                self.send_error(404); return
            path = ROOT / name[4:]

                self.send_error(404); return

            mime = {'.js': 'text/javascript', '.html': 'text/html', '.css': 'text/css', '.svg': 'image/svg+xml'}.get(path.suffix, 'application/octet-stream')
        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header('Content-Type', mime)

        self.send_header('Cache-Control', 'no-store')
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)
